deno.scope: Alternating release compiler builds and same-engine Wasm calls. No body instrumentation. Wall times include the host ownership boundary; counters measure traffic, not peak live bytes. Each compiler uses its pinned standard library.

wasmtime.scope:
Replay the pinned runtime-boundaries results with Wasmtime's Python host.

Use the same baseline/candidate Wasm produced by runtime_boundaries.ts. Times
include three Python/Wasmtime function calls, ownership checks and the ownership
boundary per invocation.

firefox.engine: Mozilla/5.0 (X11; Linux x86_64; rv:157.0) Gecko/20100101 Firefox/157.0
firefox.scope: Headless Firefox, isolated profile with timer rounding disabled. Uninstrumented Wasm and ownership enter/leave. Same pinned binaries and counter budgets as the native-host suite.

application_runtime.scope: Three counterbalanced process rounds; frozen input tapes; 600 warmup and 600 measured frames. Raw optimized Wasm, Node/V8 inspector at 1 kHz. guest_ms excludes between-frame host work; process CPU includes startup, restore, all 1200 frames, validation and witness hashing. Timed without competing builds/tests.

application_compile.scope: Three alternating fresh compiler processes, cache disabled, frozen gdev source and native assets, no profiling. Build CPU excludes startup/open. Shared-host screen; no ordinary-edit claim.

measurement.scope: Fresh native build including native assets, with retained/restart caches disabled; CPU excludes process startup/project opening; RSS is compiler process only.

acyclic_reduction.scope: LLVM release compilers, optimized uninstrumented Wasm; alternating cases with exact witnesses, roots/leases and stable memory. Compile cost is one unsampled screen.

profile_overhead.scope: Diagnostic overhead only; same optimized source, alternating raw and --profile-memory Wasm. Exact checksums, matching production counters, ownership enter/leave.
